sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Deal magic damage (Dark) 3 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 70 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 50 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 120 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Emerald King's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases DEF and MDEF by 100%, increases ATK and MATK for all allies by 100%. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 120 seconds.
Light and Dark Defense from Unison Damage +600
